end.summary: Aarav practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline; one attempt was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying what archaeological remains, inscriptions, texts, and oral traditions can tell us. Aarav named several source types and later noted that sources should be cross-checked. The century mix-up about 1857/1947 and the idea that one source gives the whole truth were not corrected by the end; at home, practise placing dates such as 1857 and 1947 into century boxes and compare two sources about the same event.
